reply_text:
*Found one merge-blocking bug.*

*P1 — View-only shares can edit unlocked documents* — `src/guard.js:12`

`share.mask & WRITE === WRITE` is parsed as `share.mask & (WRITE === WRITE)`, so it checks bit `1` (`READ`), not bit `4` (`WRITE`).

Confirmed:
• `{ mask: READ, locked: false }` incorrectly allows editing.
• `{ mask: WRITE, locked: false }` incorrectly denies editing.

Use `hasRight(share.mask, WRITE) && !share.locked`, consistent with `canComment`, or parenthesize the bitwise expression.

All six existing tests pass because the edit tests use a mask containing both READ and WRITE, hiding the bug. Add cases for an unlocked read-only share and a WRITE-only share.

I reviewed the full diff against `main` and checked all 16 masks with both lock states. No other concrete issues found. No files changed.
